title: Replication Package for "Blockchain-Based Digital Diploma Prototype: Administrative-Blockchain Divergence and Recovery in Dual-Layer Verification"
description:
Replication package supporting the study Blockchain-Based Digital Diploma Prototype: Administrative-Blockchain Divergence and Recovery in Dual-Layer Verification.

The archive contains the fixed-seed synthetic dataset generator, deployed smart-contract source, raw experimental measurements underlying Tables 5–9 and Figure 5, provenance records with SHA-256 checksums, plotting scripts, and experiment scripts. All student records are synthetic. Subsystem source revisions, integrity-verification instructions, and reproduction procedures are documented in the repository README and provenance package.
